arguments.name: Coastal Proving Ground - environment and release cradle
arguments.brief: Kiln-authored coastal deck, uneven shore, hangar, animated mechanical cradle, human scale truck, props and intact targets for the 79.25 metre Jaeger demo.
arguments.description: Initial complete asset kit. Material-faithful family views and three release phases reviewed. Destination placement, hero clearance and final scene lighting remain integration work.

arguments.name: Jaeger pilot ground motion helpers
arguments.brief: Preserve the complete original Jaeger geometry and add Kiln-authored activation, continuous walk, turn footwork and stop helpers.
arguments.description: Five helper clips, separate from the sixteen original clips. PilotWalk sampled in six PBR views. Runtime blends and contact IK still require destination validation.

arguments.name: Jaeger pilot flight motion helpers
arguments.brief: Kiln-authored sustained cruise, bank left/right and brake animation helpers for the original articulated Jaeger.
arguments.description: Four native helper clips. Cruise PBR poses reviewed. Camera-relative flight integration and transitions remain runtime work.
